input:
You are knight_g1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 64. the team planned Ne1 (knight_g1), but knight_g1 (amnesia) sent Nb4 instead, and that move was played, costing 300 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 11. the team planned Rxb4 (rook_a1), but rook_a1 (amnesia) sent Ra5 instead, and that move was played, costing 824 centipawns.
- On move 40. the team planned Bb6+ (bishop_c1), but rook_h1 (greed) sent Rxc8+ instead, and that move was played, costing 334 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send only your own piece's move if you are the named piece, and only that exact move (same piece, same destination square); if the plan names a different piece, do not send any move, and never substitute a different move, a capture, or a retreat unless the team explicitly re-plans.
- Even if your piece is attacked or a capture looks free, never send a move unless the team's planned move names your piece and square; if you are not the named piece, stay silent and, if you see a better move, post it in chat for the team to re-plan instead of sending it yourself, and if you are the named piece, re-read the plan right before sending and send exactly that move.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending any move, the named piece must copy the planned move's piece and destination square verbatim from the latest plan message into a chat confirmation (e.g. 'knight_g1 sending Ne1') and only then send exactly that move, while every other piece sends nothing and posts any alternative in chat for a re-plan.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
